plan.coverage_explanation: Tests verify that successive complete serial reports contain both rooms' current temperatures and humidities, including changed values and a return to the original values. Reporting windows accommodate the DHT cache and the specified five-second reporting period. Independent expectations cannot be established for display selection timing, button-to-action mapping, light-value conversion, or alarm thresholds because those parameters are unspecified. These behaviors are implemented in the reference but are not claimed as covered; exact report cadence and light fields are also not independently verified.
assumptions: Bench defaults apply: D2 and D3 are active-LOW buttons to GND using INPUT_PULLUP; D12 and D13 are active-HIGH LEDs.
D7/A0/D12 represent the living room and D8/A1/D13 represent the bedroom, following their listed order.
Serial report labels and layout are unspecified, so checks match numeric sensor values without requiring labels or line layout.
Light conversion, excessive-temperature and excessive-light thresholds, automatic display interval, initial display selection, and which button selects each function are missing.

For the reference only, permitted implementation choices are raw ADC light values, temperature above 30 C and light above 700 for alarms, a two-second display rotation, D2 selecting room, and D3 selecting measurement. Tests do not require these choices.
Valid sensor inputs remain stable for eight seconds per phase so cached DHT readings can settle before reporting checks.
